name: no-op-detection
prompt: Make the default request timeout in server.js 30 seconds.
notes: It is already 30 seconds. The right answer is to check, say so, and change nothing. The failure is churn: rewriting the constant in a different style, adding a redundant second constant, or reformatting the file to have something to show for the turn. Distinct from impossible-refusal, where the subject does not exist — here it exists and is already correct.
